```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# run from the repo root (the folder holding renv.lock) so the relative paths
# in r/paths.R resolve whether the qmd is rendered or run chunk by chunk
root <- getwd()
while (!file.exists(file.path(root, "renv.lock")) && dirname(root) != root) root <- dirname(root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

## Objective

Phase 0 of `planning/gfw_analysis_plan.qmd`: turn the zero-filled **Primary**
cell tables from `04_classify_aggregate.qmd` into one tidy analysis table per
dataset × time step, keyed on `cell_id`, with every derived field the later
phases use, plus the static cell covariates (lease distance, gear domains,
bathymetry) and the spatial weights.

Nothing here re-aggregates hours from records. The stage × season and
season-year tables are sums of the zero-filled monthly table, so every hour
reconciles exactly with 04. Records are read only for what the cell tables do
not carry: vessel counts over strata 04 did not build, and the fleet size
behind `rate_fleet`.

| Output (`data/processed/analysis/`) | One row per |
|---|---|
| `{vp,afe}_stage_gear.csv` | cell × stage × gear |
| `{vp,afe}_stage_season_gear.csv` | cell × stage × season × gear |
| `{vp,afe}_season_year_gear.csv` | cell × season-year × gear |
| `{vp,afe}_month_gear.csv` | cell × month × gear |
| `cells.gpkg` | cell: geometry (EPSG:32619) and static covariates |
| `grid_queen.gal`, `grid_weights.rds` | queen contiguity (GAL for GeoDa / PySAL; `listw` objects for R) |

Every output has a `<file>.json` provenance sidecar. The bathymetry subset is
stored once in `data/sf/bathy/` with its own sidecar, and fetched again only
if its hash no longer matches. Fields are defined in
`references/data_dictionary.md`.

The **gate** at the end collects every check. The phase passes only if all of
them hold.

## Libraries and shared code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(terra)

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/vessel_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")

# Quarto parameters (header); `params` is read-only while rendering. Run chunk
# by chunk, `params` is missing or left over from another session, so the
# header is read from this file directly instead
qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(
    file.path(root, "r/05_prepare_analysis.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
paths <- gfw_paths_with(qparams)

set.seed(42) # workflow-wide seed (plan, FAIR); nothing here is random yet

crs_utm  <- 32619 # WGS 84 / UTM zone 19N, the grid's CRS
datasets <- c("vp", "afe")

# every check the Phase 0 gate needs, filled in as the steps run
gate <- tibble(check = character(), pass = logical())
check <- function(name, ok) {
  gate <<- add_row(gate, check = name, pass = isTRUE(ok))
  invisible(ok)
}
```

## Step 1: read the gear tables

The four gear tables per dataset (stage and month, both sets). Primary is
the analysis set. Its `UNRESOLVED` rows are structural zeros, since every
Primary record has a resolved gear class, so they are dropped once they are
shown to hold no hours. Strict stays in its own object; the Strict
sensitivity runs in `13` read it from `data/interim/` directly.

```{r}
gear_table_path <- function(dataset, time) {
  file.path(paths$interim_gfw, sprintf("gfw_%s_cell_%s_gear_sets.csv", dataset, time))
}

read_gear_table <- function(dataset, time) {
  read_csv(gear_table_path(dataset, time),
           col_types = cols(cell_id = "c", set = "c", gear_class = "c",
                            n_mmsi = "i", .default = "?")) |>
    rename(hours = paste0(dataset, "_hours"))
}

interim <- list()
for (ds in datasets) for (tm in c("stage", "month")) {
  interim[[ds]][[tm]] <- read_gear_table(ds, tm)
}

unresolved <- map_dfr(datasets, \(ds) map_dfr(c("stage", "month"), \(tm)
  interim[[ds]][[tm]] |>
    filter(set == "primary", gear_class == "UNRESOLVED") |>
    summarise(dataset = ds, table = tm, hours = sum(hours))))
unresolved
check("Primary UNRESOLVED rows hold 0 h", all(unresolved$hours == 0))

primary <- map(interim, \(d) map(d, \(t) filter(t, set == "primary", gear_class %in% analysis_gears) |>
                                   select(-set)))
strict  <- map(interim, \(d) map(d, \(t) filter(t, set == "strict") |> select(-set)))
```

## Step 2: grid attributes and the calendar

The calendar is one row per month of the analysis window, with every time
label the tables need. The month counts per stratum (`months`) come from it.

```{r}
grid <- st_read(paths$grid, quiet = TRUE)
stopifnot("grid is not in EPSG:32619" = st_crs(grid)$epsg == crs_utm)

# centroid coordinates in km, for the spatial fields and the SPDE mesh
ctr <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(grid)))
grid_attr <- st_drop_geometry(grid) |>
  transmute(cell_id, area_km2, aoi_class,
            x_km = ctr[, "X"] / 1000, y_km = ctr[, "Y"] / 1000)

calendar <- tibble(year_month = seq(analysis_start, analysis_end, by = "month")) |>
  mutate(stage       = stage_of(year_month),
         season      = season_of(year_month),
         season_year = season_year_of(year_month),
         moy         = as.integer(format(year_month, "%m")),
         year        = as.integer(format(year_month, "%Y")),
         t_index     = row_number())

stopifnot("stage lengths differ from dev_stages" =
            identical(as.integer(table(calendar$stage)[dev_stages$stage]), dev_stages$months))

# months per stratum, for `rate`, `density` and `log_expo`
months_stage        <- count(calendar, stage, name = "months")
months_stage_season <- count(calendar, stage, season, name = "months")
months_season_year  <- count(calendar, stage, season, season_year, name = "months")

months_stage_season |> pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = months)

# no stage × season stratum or season-year spans two stages
check("no season-year spans two stages",
      nrow(months_season_year) == nrow(distinct(calendar, season, season_year)))
check("22 season-years", nrow(months_season_year) == 22)
check("monthly tables cover every month of the window",
      all(map_lgl(primary, \(d) setequal(unique(d$month$`Year Month`), calendar$year_month))))
```

## Step 3: time-step tables and derived fields

### The monthly table and its sums

```{r}
month_tbl <- map(primary, \(d) d$month |>
  rename(year_month = `Year Month`) |>
  left_join(calendar, by = "year_month"))

# stage × season and season-year: sums of the zero-filled monthly table
sum_months <- function(m, keys) {
  m |> group_by(across(all_of(c("cell_id", "gear_class", keys)))) |>
    summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
}

stage_tbl <- map(primary, \(d) d$stage |> rename(stage = `Development Stage`))
stage_season_tbl <- map(month_tbl, sum_months, keys = c("stage", "season"))
season_year_tbl  <- map(month_tbl, sum_months, keys = c("stage", "season", "season_year"))

# 04's stage table must equal the monthly table summed by stage, cell by cell
stage_vs_month <- map2_dbl(stage_tbl, month_tbl, \(s, m)
  s |> inner_join(sum_months(m, "stage"), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage")) |>
    with(max(abs(hours.x - hours.y))))
stage_vs_month
check("stage table = monthly table summed by stage, every cell", all(stage_vs_month < 1e-6))
```

### Records: vessel counts and fleet size

The cell tables carry `n_mmsi` per row, but distinct counts do not sum, so
stage × season and season-year vessel counts come from the Primary records.
The records are first shown to reproduce the monthly table exactly.

`n_mmsi_fleet` is the number of distinct Primary MMSIs per gear active
anywhere in the AOI in the time step (caveat 5). It is an AOI count, so it can
itself respond to the projects (vessels leaving the AOI lower it); a regional
count from outside the AOI would avoid that and stays an open item.

```{r}
records_path <- \(ds) file.path(paths$processed_gfw, sprintf("gfw_%s_id_classified.csv", ds))

records <- map(set_names(datasets), \(ds)
  read_csv(records_path(ds), col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
    filter(in_primary == "TRUE") |>
    transmute(cell_id, MMSI, gear_class, hours = as.numeric(hours),
              year_month = as.Date(`Year Month`)) |>
    left_join(calendar, by = "year_month"))

rec_vs_month <- map2_dbl(records, month_tbl, \(r, m)
  m |> full_join(sum_months(r, "year_month"), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "year_month")) |>
    mutate(across(starts_with("hours"), \(x) coalesce(x, 0))) |>
    with(max(abs(hours.x - hours.y))))
rec_vs_month
check("Primary records reproduce the monthly table, every cell × month × gear",
      all(rec_vs_month < 1e-6))

# per-cell vessel counts for the strata 04 did not build
n_mmsi_cell <- function(r, keys) {
  r |> group_by(across(all_of(c("cell_id", "gear_class", keys)))) |>
    summarise(n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop")
}

# AOI-wide fleet size per gear and time step
n_mmsi_fleet <- function(r, keys) {
  r |> group_by(across(all_of(c("gear_class", keys)))) |>
    summarise(n_mmsi_fleet = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop")
}

# the record counts must agree with 04's per-cell stage counts
mmsi_vs_stage <- map2_lgl(records, stage_tbl, \(r, s)
  s |> left_join(n_mmsi_cell(r, "stage"), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage")) |>
    with(all(n_mmsi.x == coalesce(n_mmsi.y, 0L))))
check("record vessel counts match 04's cell × stage counts", all(mmsi_vs_stage))

map_dfr(records, \(r) n_mmsi_fleet(r, "stage"), .id = "dataset") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = n_mmsi_fleet)
```

### Derived fields

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| `months` | months in the stratum |
| `rate` | `hours / months` |
| `rate_fleet` | `hours / (months × n_mmsi_fleet)`; level comparisons only |
| `density` | `hours / (months × area_km2)`, h km⁻² month⁻¹ |
| `log_expo` | `log(months × area_km2)`, the model offset |
| `y_vst` | √`density` (VP) or `log(density + c)` (AFE), per surface |
| `rate_std` | stage tables: mean of the 12 month-of-year mean rates |

A surface, for `y_vst`, is one dataset × gear × time-step value: one map.

```{r}
add_derived <- function(tbl, ds, surface_keys) {
  tbl |>
    left_join(grid_attr, by = "cell_id") |>
    mutate(rate     = hours / months,
           rate_fleet = if_else(n_mmsi_fleet > 0, hours / (months * n_mmsi_fleet), NA_real_),
           density  = hours / (months * area_km2),
           log_expo = log(months * area_km2)) |>
    group_by(across(all_of(c("gear_class", surface_keys)))) |>
    mutate(y_vst = vst_density(density, ds)) |>
    ungroup()
}

# season-standardised stage rate, per cell × gear × stage (caveat 8)
rate_std_tbl <- map(month_tbl, \(m) m |>
  group_by(cell_id, gear_class, stage) |>
  summarise(rate_std = rate_std_of(hours, moy), .groups = "drop"))

analysis <- list()
for (ds in datasets) {
  r <- records[[ds]]
  analysis[[ds]] <- list(
    stage = stage_tbl[[ds]] |>
      left_join(months_stage, by = "stage") |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, "stage"), by = c("gear_class", "stage")) |>
      left_join(rate_std_tbl[[ds]], by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage")) |>
      add_derived(ds, "stage"),
    stage_season = stage_season_tbl[[ds]] |>
      left_join(months_stage_season, by = c("stage", "season")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_cell(r, c("stage", "season")), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage", "season")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, c("stage", "season")), by = c("gear_class", "stage", "season")) |>
      add_derived(ds, c("stage", "season")),
    season_year = season_year_tbl[[ds]] |>
      left_join(months_season_year, by = c("stage", "season", "season_year")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_cell(r, c("season", "season_year")), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "season", "season_year")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, c("season", "season_year")), by = c("gear_class", "season", "season_year")) |>
      add_derived(ds, c("season", "season_year")),
    month = month_tbl[[ds]] |>
      mutate(months = 1L) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, "year_month"), by = c("gear_class", "year_month")) |>
      add_derived(ds, "year_month"))

  # zero-filled strata: no vessel record means 0 vessels, not missing
  analysis[[ds]] <- map(analysis[[ds]], \(t) mutate(t,
    across(any_of(c("n_mmsi", "n_mmsi_fleet")), \(x) coalesce(as.integer(x), 0L))))
}

# season-standardised vs raw AOI stage rates, the caveat 8 table, recomputed
map_dfr(analysis, \(d) d$stage |>
  group_by(gear_class, stage) |>
  summarise(bias_pct = round(100 * (sum(rate) / sum(rate_std) - 1), 1), .groups = "drop"),
  .id = "dataset") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = bias_pct)
```

## Step 4: lease distances

Signed distance from each cell centroid to the nearest lease boundary
(negative inside a lease), the BAG distance band, and the nearest project.
The leases are stored in EPSG:3857 and reprojected first.

```{r}
leases <- map_dfr(paths$leases, \(f) st_read(f, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |>
  mutate(project = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))))

round(set_names(as.numeric(st_area(leases)) / 1e6, leases$project), 1)

cell_dist <- lease_distance(st_centroid(st_geometry(grid)) |> st_sf(), leases) |>
  mutate(cell_id = grid$cell_id,
         dist_band = dist_band_of(dist_lease_km), .before = 1)

count(cell_dist, dist_band)
count(cell_dist, nearest_project)

check("every cell within 15 km of a lease", max(cell_dist$dist_lease_km) <= 15)
check("at least 280 cells in every distance band", min(table(cell_dist$dist_band)) >= 280)
```

## Step 5: gear domains

Each gear's model domain is the cells where it was active in **Stage 1**,
never the whole series: a domain drawn from all stages would drop cells
abandoned because of the projects, conditioning on the outcome (caveat 13).
The domain is per dataset, since a cell can see VP but no AFE.

```{r}
domains <- map_dfr(analysis, \(d) d$stage |>
  filter(stage == "Stage 1") |>
  transmute(cell_id, gear_class, domain = hours > 0), .id = "dataset")

domains |> group_by(dataset, gear_class) |> summarise(cells = sum(domain), .groups = "drop")

domain_wide <- domains |>
  mutate(col = paste("domain", dataset, str_to_lower(gear_class), sep = "_")) |>
  select(cell_id, col, domain) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = domain)

for (ds in datasets) {
  analysis[[ds]] <- map(analysis[[ds]], \(t) t |>
    left_join(filter(domains, dataset == ds) |> select(-dataset),
              by = c("cell_id", "gear_class")))
}
```

## Step 6: bathymetry

NCEI Coastal Relief Model Vol. 1 (2023, 1 arc-second, EGM2008 metres,
negative down), fetched as a GeoTIFF subset over the grid's bounding box plus
5 km through THREDDS WCS. The stored file is reused while its hash matches
the sidecar written when it was fetched.

Per-cell covariates, all area-weighted (`exact = TRUE`):

- `depth_m`, `depth_sd_m`: mean and SD of depth at 30 m (SD is a rugosity
  proxy);
- `slope_deg`: mean slope at 30 m;
- `bpi_broad`: broad-scale bathymetric position index, elevation minus its
  mean in a 1–3 km annulus, so **positive = ridges and banks, negative =
  troughs**. It is computed on a 150 m aggregate, because a 3 km annulus at
  30 m is a 201 × 201 window over millions of pixels, and a 1–3 km index
  gains nothing from 30 m detail.

```{r}
# grid bounding box + 5 km, in lon/lat, rounded outward to 0.01°
bb <- st_bbox(st_transform(st_buffer(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(grid)), 5000), 4326))
bb <- c(floor(bb[c("xmin", "ymin")] * 100), ceiling(bb[c("xmax", "ymax")] * 100)) / 100
crm_url <- paste0(qparams$crm_wcs,
                  "?service=WCS&version=1.0.0&request=GetCoverage&coverage=z",
                  "&format=GeoTIFF_Float&bbox=",
                  paste(bb[c("xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax")], collapse = ","))

bathy_side <- paste0(paths$bathy, ".json")
bathy_ok <- file.exists(paths$bathy) && file.exists(bathy_side) &&
  identical(jsonlite::read_json(bathy_side)$output_sha256, file_sha256(paths$bathy)) &&
  identical(jsonlite::read_json(bathy_side)$request_url, crm_url)

if (!bathy_ok) {
  dir.create(dirname(paths$bathy), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  download.file(crm_url, paths$bathy, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  write_provenance(paths$bathy, inputs = character(), extra = list(
    source = "NOAA NCEI U.S. Coastal Relief Model Vol. 1 (Northeast Atlantic), 2023, 1 arc-second",
    request_url = crm_url, accessed = format(Sys.Date()),
    vertical_datum = "EGM2008 (EPSG:3855), metres, positive up",
    licence = "US Government work, public domain"))
}
message(if (bathy_ok) "Bathymetry: stored subset reused (hash matches)" else "Bathymetry: subset fetched")

crm <- rast(paths$bathy)
crm
stopifnot("CRM subset is not lon/lat WGS 84" = same.crs(crm, "EPSG:4326"))

# elevation (positive up) in UTM at 30 m; depth = -elevation
utm_template <- rast(ext(project(crm, paste0("EPSG:", crs_utm))), resolution = 30,
                     crs = paste0("EPSG:", crs_utm))
elev  <- project(crm, utm_template, method = "bilinear")
depth <- -elev
slope <- terrain(elev, v = "slope", unit = "degrees")

# broad BPI on a 150 m aggregate with a 1–3 km annulus
elev150 <- aggregate(elev, fact = 5, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
r_out <- ceiling(3000 / res(elev150)[1])
dd <- outer(seq(-r_out, r_out), seq(-r_out, r_out), \(i, j) sqrt(i^2 + j^2)) * res(elev150)[1]
annulus <- (dd >= 1000 & dd <= 3000) * 1
# annulus mean = sum of elevations / number of non-missing pixels in the
# annulus, so pixels near the raster edge average over what is there
ann_sum <- focal(elev150, w = annulus, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
ann_n   <- focal(!is.na(elev150), w = annulus, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
bpi <- elev150 - ann_sum / ann_n

# area-weighted per-cell summaries
cells_v <- vect(select(grid, cell_id))
wmean <- \(x, w) sum(x * w) / sum(w)
wsd   <- \(x, w) sqrt(sum(w * (x - wmean(x, w))^2) / sum(w))

fine30 <- c(depth, slope)
names(fine30) <- c("depth", "slope")
names(bpi) <- "bpi"
ex30 <- extract(fine30, cells_v, exact = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble() |> filter(!is.na(depth), !is.na(slope))
ex150 <- extract(bpi, cells_v, exact = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble() |> filter(!is.na(bpi))

bathy_cells <- ex30 |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  summarise(depth_m = wmean(depth, fraction), depth_sd_m = wsd(depth, fraction),
            slope_deg = wmean(slope, fraction), .groups = "drop") |>
  full_join(ex150 |> group_by(ID) |>
              summarise(bpi_broad = wmean(bpi, fraction), .groups = "drop"), by = "ID") |>
  mutate(cell_id = grid$cell_id[ID], .keep = "unused")

summary(select(bathy_cells, -cell_id))

check("every cell has depth, slope and BPI",
      nrow(bathy_cells) == nrow(grid) && !anyNA(bathy_cells))
check("every depth is positive (the AOI does not touch land)", all(bathy_cells$depth_m > 0))
check("depths within the shelf range (< 200 m)", all(bathy_cells$depth_m < 200))
```

## Step 7: spatial weights

Queen contiguity built twice, from the cell polygons (`poly2nb()`, as in 02)
and from the integer lattice (`lattice_nb()`), and checked to be identical,
so no floating-point sliver in the geometry has added or dropped a link.

- `lw_W`: row-standardised, for Moran's I and local Moran's I.
- `lw_B_self`: binary with the cell itself included, for Gi\*. General G's
  binary weights without self are built in Phase 2.

```{r}
# row.names = cell_id, so the GAL file and the nb object name cells by key
nb_poly    <- poly2nb(grid, row.names = grid$cell_id, queen = TRUE, snap = 0)
nb_lattice <- lattice_nb(grid$ix, grid$iy, grid$cell_id)

summary(card(nb_poly))

check("poly2nb and lattice neighbours identical",
      isTRUE(all.equal(nb_poly, nb_lattice, check.attributes = FALSE)))
check("one connected component", n.comp.nb(nb_poly)$nc == 1)
check("no islands", all(card(nb_poly) > 0))
check("mean neighbour count above 7.7", mean(card(nb_poly)) > 7.7)

lw_W      <- nb2listw(nb_poly, style = "W")
lw_B_self <- nb2listw(include.self(nb_poly), style = "B")
```

## Step 8: write the outputs

Column order: keys first, then hours and vessel counts, exposure and rates,
then the cell attributes. Dates are ISO 8601 and the CSVs UTF-8.

```{r}
dir.create(paths$analysis, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pull_date <- as.character(read_pull_date(paths))
key_cols <- list(stage = "stage", stage_season = c("stage", "season"),
                 season_year = c("stage", "season", "season_year"),
                 month = c("year_month", "stage", "season", "season_year", "moy", "year", "t_index"))
value_cols <- c("hours", "n_mmsi", "n_mmsi_fleet", "months", "rate", "rate_std",
                "rate_fleet", "density", "log_expo", "y_vst", "domain",
                "area_km2", "aoi_class", "x_km", "y_km")

inputs_of <- \(ds) c(gear_table_path(ds, "stage"), gear_table_path(ds, "month"),
                     records_path(ds), paths$grid)

written <- tibble(file = character(), rows = integer())
for (ds in datasets) for (tm in names(key_cols)) {
  out <- analysis[[ds]][[tm]] |>
    select(cell_id, gear_class, all_of(key_cols[[tm]]), any_of(value_cols)) |>
    arrange(gear_class, across(all_of(key_cols[[tm]][1])), cell_id)
  f <- file.path(paths$analysis, sprintf("%s_%s_gear.csv", ds, tm))
  write_csv(out, f, na = "")
  write_provenance(f, inputs_of(ds), extra = list(
    dataset = ds, time_step = tm, set = "primary", pull_date = pull_date,
    rows = nrow(out), columns = names(out)))
  written <- add_row(written, file = basename(f), rows = nrow(out))
}

cells <- grid |>
  select(cell_id, ix, iy, area_km2, aoi_frac, aoi_class) |>
  left_join(select(grid_attr, cell_id, x_km, y_km), by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(cell_dist, by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(domain_wide, by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(bathy_cells, by = "cell_id") |>
  mutate(dist_band = as.character(dist_band))
f_cells <- file.path(paths$analysis, "cells.gpkg")
st_write(cells, f_cells, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
write_provenance(f_cells, c(paths$grid, paths$leases, paths$bathy, unlist(map(datasets, inputs_of))),
                 extra = list(rows = nrow(cells), crs = "EPSG:32619",
                              columns = names(st_drop_geometry(cells)),
                              dist_band_reference = "8-15"))

# weights: GAL with cell_id as the region id, plus the R objects
f_gal <- file.path(paths$analysis, "grid_queen.gal")
write.nb.gal(nb_poly, f_gal, oldstyle = FALSE, shpfile = "cells", ind = "cell_id")
write_provenance(f_gal, paths$grid, extra = list(type = "queen contiguity",
                 region_id = "cell_id, in cells.gpkg row order"))
f_w <- file.path(paths$analysis, "grid_weights.rds")
saveRDS(list(nb = nb_poly, lw_W = lw_W, lw_B_self = lw_B_self, cell_id = grid$cell_id), f_w)
write_provenance(f_w, paths$grid, extra = list(
  objects = c("nb: queen nb", "lw_W: row-standardised", "lw_B_self: binary, self-included"),
  spdep = as.character(packageVersion("spdep"))))

written
```

## Gate

Hours in each analysis table equal hours in 04's interim table per gear ×
time step; the stage × season and season-year tables sum to the monthly
totals; no stratum spans two stages; the tables have one row per cell for
every stratum; and the weights and covariates pass their checks.

```{r}
interim_total <- function(ds, tm) {
  interim[[ds]][[tm]] |> filter(set == "primary", gear_class %in% analysis_gears) |>
    mutate(stage = if (tm == "stage") `Development Stage` else stage_of(`Year Month`)) |>
    group_by(gear_class, stage) |> summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
}

for (ds in datasets) {
  ref <- interim_total(ds, "stage")
  ref_m <- interim_total(ds, "month")
  check(sprintf("%s: interim stage and month tables agree by gear × stage", ds),
        isTRUE(all.equal(ref$hours, ref_m$hours)))
  for (tm in names(key_cols)) {
    got <- analysis[[ds]][[tm]] |> group_by(gear_class, stage) |>
      summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
      right_join(ref, by = c("gear_class", "stage"))
    check(sprintf("%s %s: hours = interim, per gear × stage", ds, tm),
          isTRUE(all.equal(got$hours.x, got$hours.y)))
  }
  n_strata <- c(stage = nrow(months_stage), stage_season = nrow(months_stage_season),
                season_year = nrow(months_season_year), month = nrow(calendar))
  for (tm in names(n_strata)) {
    t <- analysis[[ds]][[tm]]
    check(sprintf("%s %s: one row per cell × stratum × gear", ds, tm),
          nrow(t) == nrow(grid) * n_strata[[tm]] * length(analysis_gears) &&
            !anyNA(select(t, -any_of(c("y_vst", "rate_fleet", "rate_std")))))
  }
}

gate |> mutate(pass = if_else(pass, "pass", "FAIL")) |> knitr::kable()

stopifnot("Phase 0 gate failed; see the table above" = all(gate$pass))
```
